primaryMetric: API-equivalent worker cost plus actual billed routing/review API cost, divided by independently accepted completed tasks; all attempts and failures remain in the numerator.

costBoundaries.actualBilledAPI: Only metered provider charges recorded by the harness; Codex subscription workers are not presented as API charges.
costBoundaries.apiEquivalentWorkerEstimate: Observed worker input, cached-input, cache-write and output tokens valued at the dated Standard short-context API rates for the exact worker model.
costBoundaries.subscriptionUsage: Observed account-window percentage-point changes only. No conversion to dollars or inferred quota multiplier.

claimBoundary: This four-case development comparison can compare these exact runs only. It cannot establish general savings, quota conversion, production reliability or held-out quality.
